title: Design System: Myat Thu, Record of Service

name.purpose: The one monumental element. Archivo 600 at wdth 92, tracked to -0.035em.

part.purpose: Names each part of the sheet: the record, case files, credentials.

close.purpose: The sign-off statement, the only other type allowed near display scale.

role.purpose: The job title on a rack unit and the heading on a case file.

lede.purpose: One paragraph under a part heading, capped at the measure.

body.purpose: Scope paragraphs, bullets and spec values. 17px at 1.6.

ui.purpose: Controls, spec values, organisation and credential names: 16px, the step between body and the value.

value.purpose: Dates, issuers, credential IDs, the to-now span and photo credits. 13px, plain width, tabular, sentence case.

annotation.purpose: Condensed caps at wdth 80, tracked 0.1em, always 12px: every label, flag, caption, field and year tick. Nothing on the sheet is smaller.

dimension.purpose: The date span beside a rack unit, read as the unit's position on the scale. A value, not a label: 13px, plain width, sentence case.

tick.purpose: A year on the left-hand scale in the first viewport. One tick per year from 2026 (top) to 2019 (bottom), evenly spaced, so the scale is to scale.

field.purpose: Drawing number, revision and sheet count in the strip, title block and sign-off.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing in the stylesheet. State changes, hover, the disclosure cross, the opening.

motion.name: t
motion.purpose: The only transition duration. Hover, focus and disclosure all run at it.

motion.name: plot
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the datum draws itself across the sheet on load.

motion.name: ink
motion.purpose: The year ticks on the scale appear in sequence behind the datum.

motion.name: is-plotting
motion.value: class gate on the html element
motion.purpose: main.js adds it only when the tab is visible and motion is welcome. The stylesheet default is the finished state, so nothing can be stranded invisible in a background tab or with scripts off.

narrative.overview: The record drawn as the document this trade actually signs off: a dimensioned elevation with a title block, not a styled CV. A cool drafting sheet, never cream. One variable face, Archivo, condensed caps for every annotation and tabular figures on every number. The patch-cable code is the only colour and it marks state alone. The visitor reads the title block, learns who this is and what to do in one glance, then reads down the elevation: four roles as rack units with their years as dimensions, three case files as detail callouts, four certifications as verified items carrying credential IDs, study and kit as a schedule, Poker Money as the one detail drawn out. They act from the title block or the close.
keyCharacteristics: A cool sheet at #eceef0 and ink at #10161c. Never cream, never a dark terminal.
True 1px hairlines are the only divider. No shadows anywhere in the stylesheet.
Archivo alone, condensed caps at wdth 80 for annotation and plain for reading.
Tabular figures globally, so every date and dimension column lines up.
Colour is state and nothing else: blue current, amber in progress, red escalation, green verified.
One element owns the first viewport at full scale, the title block, lower right where a drawing puts it.
Every destination is a drawn control with a visible border. Nothing is found by hovering.
One datum line the whole sheet hangs from, and one scale running its full height.
rules: One identical label schema on every rack unit and every credential row, so the sheet scans in a single pass.
Colour may only mark state. A colour used for emphasis, decoration or mood is a defect.
Every rule is 1px and either --rule, --rule-2 or --ink. There is no thick stripe: the live marker is a square swatch.
No shadow, no gradient, no glass, no rounded corner. Radius is zero everywhere.
Reading columns are capped at the 68ch measure. Only the elevation, the schedule and the rules run full width.
Motion is one authored moment plus 180ms state transitions. Anything else is removed.
The opening must be gated so the finished state is the default. A hidden tab or a blocked script must never leave a visitor a blank sheet.
No libraries and no build step. The stylesheet and the short main.js are the whole front end.
Every claim traces to the CV, the signed position description or the Poker Money README.
dos: Draw a component rather than style a box: rails, leader lines, plates, a legend, a revision block.
Put a number in tabular figures and give it a column.
Label with condensed caps at 12px and let the label carry the annotation voice. Set the values a recruiter reads in the plain width at 13px.
Give a photograph a bordered plate and an annotated caption, in grayscale.
Use a native element when one exists. The credential rows are details elements and need no script.
Keep one filled control per frame, always email.
Cap a new reading column at the measure.
donts: Do not add a kicker or an eyebrow above a heading.
Do not tint a surface, a border or a heading with a patch colour to make it feel designed.
Do not introduce a second typeface, a monospace face, or a system display stack.
Do not reach for a shadow or a radius to separate two things. Use a hairline or space.
Do not hide a destination behind a hover, an overlay or a gesture.
Do not animate anything on scroll, and do not reintroduce a library to do it.
Do not warm the ground toward cream. The sheet is cool by decision.
Do not set any text under 12px, and do not mark a unit with a side stripe.
